kpis.explanation: Objectif de nombre de chambres à atteindre d'ici 2020.
kpis.signal: Ambition claire d'expansion physique soutenue, avec un objectif de 85 000 chambres d'ici 2020.
kpis.description: Whitbread vise environ 85 000 chambres au Royaume-Uni d'ici 2020, contre 60 841 en 2015, représentant une croissance de 24 159 chambres.

company_description: Whitbread plc operates hotels and restaurants in the United Kingdom, Germany, and internationally. The company operates hotels under the Premier Inn, ZIP by Premier Inn, and hub by Premier Inn brands. It also operates restaurants under the Brewers Fayre, Beefeater, Cookhouse and Pub, Bar+Block Steakhouse, Thyme, Whitebread Inns, and Table Table brands. The company was founded in 1742 and is headquartered in Dunstable, the United Kingdom.
